title: fix(enroll): settings.local.json is an arrow to settings.of.repo.json; no machine-local settings committed
description:
## .what

in the repo actor brain dir (`.agent/.actors/actor.via.repo=ambient/brain/.claude/`), make `settings.local.json` a relative symlink to `settings.of.repo.json`, the way `settings.json -> settings.of.grove.json` is an arrow today. findsert it in `setBrainDirSettingsLayout`.

## .why

- today `setRepoActorBrainDir.ts` allowlists `!/settings.local.json`, so a human's real `settings.local.json` gets committed. that file is claude's per-machine "yes, don't ask again" log: absolute `/home/<user>/...` paths, commands for files long deleted. in a public repo that is dox, and it is noise everywhere else
- `define.brain-dir-layout-is-one-for-every-actor` already says `settings.local.json` "is not part of the layout; no clone reads it", and the earlier `.default` layout ignored `*.local.json` (`setRepoBrainDirSymlink.integration.test.ts:206`). the allowlist line contradicts both
- an arrow gives the name ONE answer, rhachet's: whatever reads claude's project-local layer meets the role-derived repo settings, never a stale personal log

## .owed decisions

1. **a write through the arrow.** claude writes `settings.local.json` when a human picks "don't ask again". if it writes THROUGH the link, a personal approval lands in the tracked `settings.of.repo.json` and is wiped at the next derive; if it renames over the link, the arrow becomes a real file again. measure which claude does, then converge: the layout findsert replaces a real file at an arrow name, as it already does for `settings.json` (one answer, rhachet's)
2. **an extant real file.** a human's current `settings.local.json` is replaced by the arrow, never merged (same rule as the grove arrows). say so in the stdout
3. **precedence.** claude ranks the local layer above the project layer; with both `--settings settings.of.repo.json` and the arrow, the repo settings load twice. confirm that is benign (arrays merge, no hook fires twice)

## .also — the grove arrow is committed with an absolute target

`settings.of.grove.json -> ~/.claude/settings.json` is allowlisted too, and its target is the EXPANDED home path (`/home/<user>/.claude/settings.json`). committed, that names the user and dangles or misroutes on every other box. rhachet re-findserts it at each enroll, so a commit of it buys naught: drop `!/settings.of.grove.json` from the allowlist (and `!/settings.json`, which only points at it), and keep `settings.of.repo.json` as the one committed settings file.

## .criteria

- `settings.local.json` is an arrow to `settings.of.repo.json` after any `rhx init` / `rhx enroll`; idempotent
- a real file at that name is replaced by the arrow
- `git status` in a fresh repo shows no settings file with an absolute path or a username
- update `setRepoActorBrainDir.integration.test.ts`, `setBrainDirSettingsLayout.integration.test.ts` [case7], and the `upgrade.default-actor-migration` acceptance snapshot that pins `!/settings.local.json`

first seen in `uladkasach/dev-env-setup` on main, 2026-10-15, when a staged release carried the actor dir's `settings.local.json` and `settings.of.grove.json`.
